description: This file defines the UtilityPaymentService class, which provides methods for processing utility payments and reading payment records. It interacts with repositories, external REST clients, and uses data mappers to handle utility payment transactions.

classes.name: UtilityPaymentService
classes.description: Service class for handling utility payment processing and retrieval.

methods.name: utilPayment
methods.description: Processes a utility payment request, saves initial entity, calls external REST client for payment, updates transaction status, and returns a response.

methods.name: readPayments
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of utility payments converted to DTOs.
